extension.description: Pentest workspace for VS Code: missions, terminals, evidence, and reports, with optional AI.
extension.untrustedWorkspaces: RedWidow runs an agent that reads and modifies workspace files: it is disabled until the folder is trusted.
command.captureTerminalEvidence: RedWidow: Capture a terminal log excerpt
command.exportKillchain: RedWidow: Export the Kill chain as an SVG image
command.exportReport: RedWidow: Export a Markdown draft report
command.openWorkspace: RedWidow: Open or restore the RedWidow workspace
command.prepareMission: RedWidow: Prepare and check the mission folder
command.chooseProfile: RedWidow: Choose an agent skill / profile
command.testBurp: RedWidow: Test the Burp Suite MCP connection
config.opencodeProviders: Explicitly configured OpenAI-compatible OpenCode providers (URL and models). No secrets: use OpenCode’s native authentication cache. Repository values are ignored.
config.profile: Short methodological profile, applied on the next turn. Sources are loaded on demand.
config.integrationsByProject: Explicitly configured local MCP services. Ignored in the repository; use the RedWidow catalog.
config.burp.enabled: Expose local Burp Suite MCP to agents. Ignored in folder settings. The next turns use the new settings.
config.burp.port: Port of the Burp MCP server on 127.0.0.1. No remote server or Java command is launched by RedWidow.
config.burp.transport: Transport of the MCP server installed in Burp Suite.
config.terminalPrompt: Prompt for new Docker Bash terminals opened by RedWidow. Existing terminals and shell configuration files are unchanged.
config.terminalPrompt.enum.1: RedWidow: two lines, user, host and current directory
config.terminalPrompt.enum.2: Compact: user, host and current directory on one line
config.palette.enum.0: Deep black and crimson: the RedWidow identity
config.palette.enum.1: Teal and slate: monitoring, terminal, security
config.palette.enum.2: Crimson and steel: the original, more offensive brand
config.palette.enum.3: Toxic green on steel: terminal, offensive
config.model: Model to use (free text). Empty: SDK default. Ignored when set at workspace level.
config.maxTurns: Maximum number of agent turns per conversation. 0: no limit.
config.ultracode.maxTurns: Turn limit for the **Ultracode** preset (Max effort + long limits). 0: no turn limit. Overrides `warband.maxTurns` when Ultracode is selected.
config.ultracode.maxBudgetUsd: Spending limit (USD) for the **Ultracode** preset. 0: no spending limit.
config.language: RedWidow interface language. Native menus and settings follow the VS Code language.
config.chat.providers: Providers available in the chat. Configure connections in Settings → System control.
config.chat.skills: Method profiles available in the chat + menu. Select a profile for each conversation.
config.chat.integrations: MCP connectors available in the chat + menu after configuration. Disabling preserves configuration.
config.chat.webSearch: Make web search available in the chat + menu. Each conversation chooses whether to use it.
command.disableBypass: RedWidow: Turn off the approval Bypass
config.palette.enum.5: Violet and ice: agents, research, night
config.palette.enum.7: Olive and khaki: field work, operations
config.palette.enum.9: Bright orange; close to alert colors
config.palette.enum.10: Sun yellow; close to alert colors
config.palette.enum.14: Pure white, graphite in light themes
config.palette.enum.21: Six colors: coral, green, cyan, blue, violet and pink
config.palette.enum.22: VS Code theme accent: full integration
